description.value:
Price 2,000 gp; Slot none; Weight 1 lb.

A datapad listing every adventurer who died in the Garden, with their gear, their home towns and their heirs. Its holder gains a +4 bonus on Diplomacy checks with anyone named in it or related to someone who is. Once, it identifies the original owner of one item in the hoard of the fallen.

Found in: Episode 2 (Lot 1).
